title: Controlled Substances Act (Luật Chất bị kiểm soát)

versions.text:
Controlled Substances Act (21 USC §801 et seq.).
Schedule I: High potential for abuse, no accepted medical use (heroin, LSD, marijuana under federal law).
Schedule II: High potential for abuse, accepted medical use (fentanyl, oxycodone, methamphetamine).
Schedule III: Moderate potential (ketamine, testosterone).
Schedule IV: Low potential (benzodiazepines, tramadol).
Schedule V: Lowest potential (cough preparations with codeine).
